answer: Every payout must cross a canyon on a voyage manifest: a chained log of jobs, each leg stamped by a stranger at a distinct port, so a copied manifest echoes the same stamps and exposes both copies. The canyon toll doubles with each crossing paid from one funding trail, so the k-th clone pays 2^k. The payout is an orchard harvest: each agent tends one tree that bears fruit only when three strangers tend it, and clones grafted from one funding trail share a single tree. So n clones pay a doubling toll and split one tree's fruit, while one honest agent pays one toll and eats alone.
